newsitem.title: USA: Palm Harbor Homes sees better fiscal 1998.
newsitem.headline: Palm Harbor Homes sees better fiscal 1998.

text.p: Palm Harbor Homes Inc chairman Lee Posey said at the company's annual meeting Tuesday that he expects the company to report higher net sales and earnings in fiscal 1998.
In the fiscal ended March 28, the company reported net sales of $563.2 million and net income $24.7 million, or earnings of $1.68 per share.

In other comments, Posey said "Our marketing focus remains on sustaining the company's leadership in the higher priced segment of multi-section category of the manufactured housing industry," said Posey at the company's annual meeting. "Palm Harbor's shipments of homes are ahead of the industry trends to date, and we expect to increase our share of the market for the fiscal year as a whole."
Palm Harbor Homes makes and sells multi-section manufactured homes.
